name: Lesh
description: A corrupt, merchant-ruled city on a vital trade river on Shandalar, home to cults and agents of vampires.

description_citations.text: "The Bard and the Biologist" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Jalira and Yisan, both trying to rob a rambling Thunian man warning of the skep, compete over their mark in the market of Lesh.
timeline.quote: The soothsayer, however, was so enamored by the coin that he failed to see his audience was in contention.

citation.text: "The Bard and the Biologist" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Guard commander Dexros tries to arrest Jalira and Yisan; Yisan spooks the guards' horses with a hummed tune and Jalira turns the thrown guards into frogs, and they flee.
timeline.quote: The guards transformed into tiny blue frogs, their empty clothes falling around them.

citation.text: "The Bard and the Biologist" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jul 2014.
